# make-it-look-good

> Evidence-based design knowledge base for LLMs. Concrete UI/UX guidance with hard numbers.

This repo helps AI assistants make better UI/UX decisions by providing specific design rules, copy-paste component snippets, and a structured consultation workflow.

## Start Here

- [CONSULT.md](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/CONSULT.md): Full design consultation playbook — intake, audit, code generation, design review
- [snippets/_index.md](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/snippets/_index.md): 34 HTML+Tailwind component snippets with React/Vue/Svelte variants
- [workflows/quick-reference.md](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/workflows/quick-reference.md): Critical design numbers (contrast ratios, spacing, timing)

## Knowledge Files

- [Color: Contrast & Accessibility](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/color/contrast-and-accessibility.md): 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text (WCAG AA)
- [Layout: Spacing System](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/layout/spacing-system.md): 4px/8px base unit, consistent scale
- [Typography: Type Scale](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/typography/type-scale.md): Modular scale 1.200-1.333, 16px body minimum
- [Components: Buttons](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/components/buttons.md): 3 emphasis levels, 44x44px touch targets
- [Components: Forms](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/components/forms.md): Single column, labels above, 5-7 fields per step
- [Components: Navigation](https://github.com/jdeworks/make-it-look-good/blob/main/components/navigation.md): 5-7 items max, bottom nav on mobile

## Preview Tool

- [Live Preview](https://jdeworks.github.io/make-it-look-good/): Paste HTML+Tailwind, see it rendered with mobile/tablet/desktop views
